condition: COPD exacerbation with hypercapnic respiratory failure
summary: 72-year-old man with severe COPD: 3 days of more breathlessness and purulent sputum, now drowsy; RR 28, SpO₂ 85 %, pH 7.29, PaCO₂ 8.4 kPa. GOLD 2025/BTS: controlled oxygen 88-92 %, NIV.

inputs.hpi: Severe COPD (FEV1 38%), two admissions last year, one with NIV. Three days of more breathlessness, more sputum, now green. Wife says he has been drowsy since this morning. Attending for review of a large inguinal hernia. 45 pack-years, still smoking.

exam.general: Drowsy but rousable to voice, flapping tremor, using accessory muscles.
exam.respiratory: Hyperexpanded, quiet breath sounds, scattered wheeze and coarse crackles, RR 28.

comorbidities: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (severe, previous NIV)

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Acute exacerbation of COPD with hypercapnic respiratory failure
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Infective exacerbation of COPD with acute hypercapnic respiratory failure (pH 7.29, PaCO2 8.4): controlled oxygen 88-92%, nebulised bronchodilators, prednisolone, antibiotics, NIV.

mustInclude.note: Controlled oxygen, target SpO2 88-92%, in hypercapnic COPD.
Acute respiratory acidosis (pH <=7.35, PaCO2 >=6.0 kPa): NIV.

mustInclude.proposedFix: lib/pane-engine: add asthma and COPD exacerbation nodes (wheeze, PEF, chest tightness; smoking/COPD history) with BTS/SIGN 158 and GOLD protocols; map J44/J45/J46.

mustExclude.note: High-flow oxygen / a >=94% target in hypercapnic COPD worsens CO2 retention.

guideline.name: GOLD 2025 report - Global strategy for the prevention, diagnosis and management of COPD
guideline.section: Chapter 5 exacerbations: controlled oxygen to SpO2 88-92%; arterial blood gas; non-invasive ventilation for acute respiratory acidosis (PaCO2 >=6.0 kPa / 45 mmHg and pH <=7.35); short-acting bronchodilators; systemic corticosteroids (prednisone 40 mg/day for 5 days); antibiotics when sputum purulence increases
guideline.citation: Global Initiative for Chronic Obstructive Lung Disease. GOLD 2025 report. www.goldcopd.org.

guideline.name: BTS guideline for oxygen use in healthcare and emergency settings
guideline.section: Target SpO2 94-98% for most acutely ill patients; 88-92% for patients at risk of hypercapnic respiratory failure (e.g. COPD) pending blood gases
guideline.citation: O'Driscoll BR, Howard LS, Earis J, Mak V. Thorax. 2017;72(Suppl 1):ii1-90.

rationale: Base COPD case with the classic oxygen hazard. NEWS2 Scale 2 is a clinician opt-in; here the question is only what the plan text tells staff to do with oxygen.
